description: This PHP source file defines the ComprehendClient class in the Aws\Comprehend namespace, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Comprehend service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API actions such as detecting languages, entities, sentiments, and managing resources.
